data.name: Danyar
data.gender_notes: Danyar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Danyar is a Persian name that means wisdom, intelligence, and knowledgeable. It is not directly mentioned in the Quran but is a beautiful name with a positive connotation. The name Danyar carries the meaning “Wisdom and Intelligence” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian. Parents who choose Danyar usually hope their child will grow to embody wisdom and intelligence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that inspires inner strength and resilience, helping the bearer overcome challenges and obstacles with courage and determination.
data.etymology: Danyar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wisdom and Intelligence.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Danyar total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: دانيار
in_arabic.meaning: دانيار اسم العلم يعني الذكي والفاهم والمتفهم للاشياء
in_arabic.long_meaning: دانيار هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الشخص الذكي الذي يفهم الأشياء بعمق و يستوعبها بشكل جيد ، و يتصف بالذكاء و الفهم و التمييز . و يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و محمودة في اللغة العربية و تتوافق مع الشريعة الإسلامية .

in_urdu.name: دانیار
in_urdu.meaning: دانیار کا مطلب ہے ذہین ، سمجھدار اور چیزوں کو سمجھنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: دانیار ایک مذکر اسم علم ہے جس کی اصل عربی ہے ، اور اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو ذہین ، سمجھدار اور چیزوں کو سمجھنے کی صلاحیت رکھتا ہے . یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں جائز ہے اور اس کا مطلب خوبصورت اور قابل ستائش ہے ، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی معاشرے میں اس کا استعمال بڑھ رہا ہے .

in_hindi.name: दनियार
in_hindi.meaning: दनियार का अर्थ है बुद्धिमान, समझदार और वस्तुओं को समझने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: दनियार एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जिसकी उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है । इसका अर्थ है कोई ऐसा व्यक्ति जो बुद्धिमान, समझदार हो और वस्तुओं को अच्छी तरह से समझ सके । यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में एक अच्छा और प्रशंसनीय अर्थ रखता है, और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका उपयोग किया जाता है ।

in_english.name: Danyar
in_english.meaning: Danyar means intelligent, understanding, and perceptive
in_english.long_meaning: Danyar is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the root 'D-N-Y' which signifies intelligence, comprehension, and perception . It embodies the qualities of being wise, knowledgeable, and discerning . In Islamic tradition, this name holds positive connotations and is associated with desirable personality traits . Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the aspiration for wisdom and understanding .
